shared_elements: frontal face with eyes and mouth
justification: Both depict anthropomorphic figures on a tall vertical monument, but A is a stacked pair of massive, frontal, bulbous heads with huge staring eyes and a bared grin carved almost in the round, while B is a flat relief of a slim profile-oriented figure in a long garment with headgear, arms crossed over the chest and small subordinate figures/objects at its side. The only correspondence is the generic idea of a human figure on an upright stone; the specific forms, postures, viewpoint (frontal grotesque mask vs. relief figure with attributes) and carving conventions are quite different.
